name: gdd
description: Turn a game idea into a comprehensive Game Design Document through guided Q&A, optional web research, parallel supplement generation, and a session index, pausing at user checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Generate Game Design Documents with a guided agent pipeline
interface.longDescription: Start from a one-line game idea and end with a 15-section Game Design Document plus supplementary documents (stats tables, item lists, lore bible, character sheets, rules references) and a navigable INDEX.md. The pipeline gathers the concept through structured Q&A, optionally runs historical, market, and technical web research in parallel, vets and synthesizes the findings, writes the GDD, recommends supplements, and generates the selected ones in parallel. Every session is resumable from state.json.
defaultPrompt: Create a Game Design Document for my game idea.
Show the status of my GDD project.
